issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Bolt Forge
products.tagline: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
products.summaryZh: Bolt的新代理，采用开源模型，使用量提升50倍
products.descriptionZh: Bolt Forge 是 Bolt.new 内的一款新智能体，基于开源模型运行。每个 Pro 方案可获得最高 50 倍的使用量，且无每日上限。在其内部基准测试中，得分达到 Bolt 顶级付费模型的 91%。
products.description: Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.

products.name: Lumiko
products.tagline: Screen recordings that edit themselves with Auto Zoom-Pan
products.summaryZh: 自动缩放平移，屏幕录制自己就能编辑
products.descriptionZh: Lumiko 在你工作时录制屏幕并剪辑素材。它追踪光标和点击，然后自动在其上构建平滑的缩放和平移运动，无需关键帧。直接在浏览器中的时间线上修剪、分割和重新排序片段。智能模糊一拖即可隐藏 API 密钥和密码。添加网络摄像头气泡、自定义背景、点击效果。导出高达 4K。本地运行，无需账户，无上传队列。免费开始。
products.description: Lumiko records your screen and edits the footage while you work. It tracks your cursor and clicks, then builds smooth zoom and pan moves over them automatically, no keyframes. Trim, split, and reorder clips on a timeline right in the browser. Smart Blur hides API keys and passwords in one drag. Add a webcam bubble, custom backgrounds, click effects. Exports up to 4K. Runs locally, no account, no upload queue. Free to start.

products.name: Squirrel
products.tagline: An app blocker that pays you back
products.summaryZh: 一款会返还你费用的应用拦截器
products.descriptionZh: Squirrel会为你频繁打开的应用标上价格。点开Instagram，你会被硬性拦截，而不是一个可以随手划掉的界面。想查看私信？可以，但你得先打开Squirrel，选择时长，并为自己预留几美元。应用内不流转任何资金，也无需绑定银行卡或银行账户。当你准备好后，自行在券商处投资，并告诉Squirrel你买了什么。它会以实时价格追踪你的持仓。
products.description: Squirrel puts a price on the apps you open too much. Tap Instagram and you get a hard block, not a screen you can wave away. Want to check a DM? That's fine, but you have to open Squirrel, pick how long, and set aside a few dollars for yourself first. No money moves through the app. No card or bank account to connect. When you're ready, invest it in your own brokerage and tell Squirrel what you bought. It tracks your holdings with live prices.

products.name: Doneit 3.2
products.tagline: Reimagined Doneit Assist, support for Siri AI, and more
products.summaryZh: 重新设计的 Doneit Assist、对 Siri AI 的支持，以及更多功能
products.descriptionZh: 现在，在使用 Doneit Assist 规划任务时，你可以附加照片，将手写清单、白板或文档转换为任务，添加更多细节以使任务更准确，并让其建议任务的提醒和属性，以及将任务分解为子任务。Doneit Assist 现在还能创建任务列表的简要总结，突出显示关键任务供你专注处理，并展示此列表中的即将到来的任务。
products.description: You can now attach photos when planning tasks with Doneit Assist to turn a handwritten list, whiteboard or a document into tasks, include additional details to make tasks more accurate, as well as let it suggest reminders and attributes for tasks, and break tasks into subtasks. Doneit Assist can now also create a brief summary of a task list, highlight its key tasks for you to focus on, as well as show the upcoming tasks in this list.

products.name: VoiceCap
products.tagline: The AI notetaker for meetings in your language
products.summaryZh: 用你的语言进行会议记录的AI笔记工具
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI笔记工具只擅长英语，其他语言表现平平。VoiceCap支持100多种语言的转录，并用同一语言生成摘要、行动项和决策。可通过原生应用在会议室录制，派机器人加入Zoom、Meet或Teams，或上传文件。每场会议都会成为可搜索的记录，清楚记录决定了什么、由谁负责。可通过MCP向Claude或ChatGPT询问会议内容。欧盟公司，录音存储在法兰克福，绝不用于训练模型。免费300分钟，无需信用卡。
products.description: Most AI notetakers are strong in English and mediocre in everything else. VoiceCap transcribes in 100+ languages and writes the summary, action items and decisions in that same language. Record in the room via native apps, send a bot to Zoom, Meet or Teams, or upload a file. Every meeting becomes a searchable record of what was decided and who owns it. Ask Claude or ChatGPT about it over MCP. EU company, recordings stored in Frankfurt, never used to train models. 300 free minutes, no card.

products.name: Ruby UTCP
products.tagline: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling
products.summaryZh: 可扩展、安全的工具调用方案，可替代 MCP
products.descriptionZh: Ruby UTCP 将 UTCP 1.1 引入 Ruby，为应用和 AI 代理提供了一种标准方式，通过原生协议发现和调用工具。它支持 12 种传输方式，包括 HTTP、CLI、WebSocket、gRPC、GraphQL、MCP 和 WebRTC，并具备流式传输、认证、OpenAPI 发现以及用于可编程多工具工作流的 CodeMode。开源，专为 Ruby 生态打造。
products.description: Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.

products.name: Mise
products.tagline: The meal planner that gets all your dishes ready at once
products.summaryZh: 让所有菜肴同时就绪的膳食规划器
products.descriptionZh: 食谱帮你做一道菜。但一顿饭有多道菜！Mise 从你想用餐的那一刻倒推，为每道菜安排时间：一个开始时间、一份执行顺序、一份合并的购物清单、一个烹饪模式。这样你就能在恰当的时间准备好一切，并按照一份简单的备餐清单来操作，清单里包含食材、步骤和提醒。免费使用，无需登录。
products.description: Recipes help you cook one dish. But meals have multiple dishes! Mise schedules every dish backwards from the minute you want to eat: one start time, one running order, a merged shopping list, a cooking mode. That way you get everything ready at the right time and can work from a simple prep list that includes ingredients, instructions, and reminders. Free with no login.

products.name: Punch
products.tagline: Save your group chat's important stuff
products.summaryZh: 保存群聊中的重要内容
products.descriptionZh: 你和朋友度假时，需要知道AirBnB地址、门禁密码、集合地点等信息。与其在100多条消息中翻找，不如把这些信息都保存在Punch上，并与亲友分享。我们的不同之处：备忘录应用：很快就会填满，时间一长显得笨重。你也无法单独分享某条备忘录中的某部分内容。还有操作系统之间不兼容的问题。Drive/Dropbox等：具备存储和分享功能，但更偏向于存储用途。
products.description: You’re on vacation with your friends and you need to know the AirBnB address, the door code, the rendezvous spot, etc. Instead of scrolling through 100+ messages, save all that info on Punch and share with your friends and family. Why we're different: Notes App: This can fill up quick and can look clunky after a while. You also can’t share individual pieces from a note. Also, incompatibility between OS. Drive/Dropbox/etc.: Has the storage/shareability aspect, but is more geared toward storage.

products.name: BiBimba
products.tagline: Clipboard history that can read your screenshots
products.summaryZh: 可读取截图的剪贴板历史记录
products.descriptionZh: 剪贴板历史与截图，一并搜索。BiBimba 能识别截图中的文字，之后你可以找到收据金额或错误信息，只粘贴所需内容。端侧 AI 可翻译、摘要、改写。全程留在你的 Mac 上。$9。
products.description: Clipboard history and screenshots, searchable together. BiBimba reads the text inside screenshots, so you can find a receipt total or an error message later and paste just what you need. On-device AI translates, summarizes, rewrites. Stays on your Mac. $9.

products.name: Lappka
products.tagline: Turn app screens into an App Store screenshots that converts
products.summaryZh: 将应用界面转化为能提升转化率的 App Store 截图
products.descriptionZh: Lappka 帮助移动应用开发者将原始应用界面转化为以转化为导向的 App Store 截图。利用 AI 制定策略和文案，再通过可编辑模板、本地化、App Store 预览和可导出截图，让每个细节都符合你的需求。
products.description: Lappka helps mobile makers turn raw app screens into a conversion-focused App Store screenshots. Use AI for strategy and copy, then make every detail yours with editable templates, localization, App Store preview, and ready-to-export screenshots.

products.name: NotchOwl
products.tagline: Turn your Mac’s notch into a sleek productivity workspace.
products.summaryZh: 将 Mac 的刘海变成一个简洁高效的工作空间。
products.descriptionZh: 任务、笔记、专注计时器和日历事件，就在 Mac 的刘海区域。悬停即达。
products.description: Tasks, notes, focus timers, and calendar events in your Mac’s notch. One hover away.

products.name: Made with Jev
products.tagline: What people are building on Jev
products.summaryZh: 人们在Jev上构建什么
products.descriptionZh: TypeSafe 推出的 Jev 是全新 AI 模型，不写文本，而是做决策，耗时不到半秒。我正在搭建一个目录，汇集所有 Jev 相关资源。来看看人们用它做出的疯狂东西：浏览器代理、游戏、邮件分类、病毒式推文分析器。每一项都附真实成本。另外还有免费的 AI 垃圾内容检测器，以及其他即将推出的工具。
products.description: Jev by TypeSafe is the new AI model that makes decisions instead of writing text, in under half a second. I'm building a directory to share all Jev related resources. Explore the insane things people built with it: browser agents, games, email triage, viral tweet analyzers. Each with its real cost. Plus a free AI slop detector and other tools coming.

products.name: One More Thing
products.tagline: Turn doomscrolling into something worth knowing.
products.summaryZh: 把无休止刷屏变成值得了解的事。
products.descriptionZh: One More Thing 把好奇心变成习惯。与其无休止地刷过转头就忘的内容，不如选一个你想了解的东西，一张卡片一张卡片地学。探索心理学、历史、科学、金钱、文化、语言、冷知识等。每个主题都变成一叠可以几分钟刷完的碎片化学习卡组。赚取 XP、累积连续学习天数、解锁徽章，每天发现新东西。少刷一点，多懂一些。总还有 One More Thing。
products.description: One More Thing turns curiosity into a habit. Instead of endless scrolling through content you’ll forget, choose something you want to know and learn it one card at a time. Explore psychology, history, science, money, culture, languages, weird facts, and more. Every topic becomes a bite-sized learning deck you can swipe through in minutes. Earn XP, build streaks, unlock badges, and discover something new every day. Scroll less. Know more. There’s always One More Thing.

products.name: LucentraCode
products.tagline: Code without the Clock
products.summaryZh: 无时钟编程
products.descriptionZh: LucentraCode 是一款为开发者打造的 AI 编程 CLI，让你无需时刻担心用量限制或高昂订阅费用，即可使用强大的模型。直接在终端运行，可从 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude、Gemini、Grok、Kimi 等模型中选择，并将其用于实际开发工作——调试、构建功能、重构、测试，以及处理更大的代码库。
products.description: LucentraCode is an AI coding CLI built for developers who want powerful models without constantly worrying about usage limits or expensive subscriptions. Run it directly from your terminal, choose from models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, and more, and use them for real development work - debugging, building features, refactoring, testing, and working across larger codebases.

products.name: IronFuel for Android
products.tagline: Now on Android: log a set, watch today's food target move
products.summaryZh: Android 版现已推出：记录一组训练，实时查看今日饮食目标进度
products.descriptionZh: 安卓举重爱好者一直在用一个健身记录应用和一个热量应用，两者互不相通。IronFuel 将它们合二为一：三次点击或语音即可记录组数，拍张照片记录一餐，训练结束后，当天的热量和蛋白质目标会根据你的消耗量自动调整。
products.description: Android lifters have been running a gym log and a calorie app that ignore each other. IronFuel joins them: log sets in three taps or by voice, photograph a meal, and when a session ends the day's calorie and protein target moves to match what you burned.

products.name: Mantra Timer
products.tagline: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
products.summaryZh: 一款适用于 iOS 的极简咒语冥想计时器。
products.descriptionZh: Mantra Meditation Timer 摒弃了现代健康应用臃肿的追踪功能。这款优雅的 iOS 应用为自主练习者打造，提供无干扰的体验，且完全不收集数据。核心冥想计时器、舒缓铃声以及身心状态记录均可免费使用。对于经验丰富的曼陀罗练习者，一次性小额付费即可解锁高级统计与更深度的自定义功能。没有订阅疲劳，只有一个精美简洁的工具，助你进行深度的日常练习。
products.description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.

products.name: Steam Frame
products.tagline: Your Steam library, now on a wearable PC
products.summaryZh: 你的Steam游戏库，现在戴在手腕上
products.descriptionZh: Steam Frame 是一款无线 SteamOS 头显，可从 PC、Deck 或 Machine 串流你的整个游戏库，也能独立运行游戏。双射频加随附适配器确保串流稳定。控制器既可作为 VR 手柄，也可作为完整游戏手柄使用。
products.description: Steam Frame is a wireless SteamOS headset that streams your whole library from a PC, Deck, or Machine, and runs standalone titles too. Dual radios plus an included adapter keep streaming stable. The controllers work as VR wands and a full gamepad.

products.name: Lull
products.tagline: Tell it what is on your mind. It writes the meditation.
products.summaryZh: 把心中所想告诉它，它便写出冥想词。
products.descriptionZh: Lull 不播放录音。你花一分钟说说当下真正发生的事，它就会为那一刻写一段冥想，并用 11 种声音中的一种朗读出来。Oura 的恢复数据会塑造语气。Apple Watch 记录你的心率，并在之后显示真实的平静过程，或者什么都不显示。
products.description: Lull doesn't play recordings. Talk for a minute about what's actually going on and it writes a meditation for that moment, read in one of 11 voices. Oura recovery shapes the tone. Apple Watch records your heart rate and shows the real settle after, or nothing.

products.name: Basedash Models
products.tagline: Define it once. Query it like a table.
products.summaryZh: 定义一次，像查询表格一样查询。
products.descriptionZh: Basedash Models 是一个语义工作区，用于管理可复用、受治理的 SQL，覆盖客户、订单、活跃账户等核心业务概念，让所有人都基于同一套可信定义开展工作。每个模型都有专门的视图，分别展示详情、列、度量和细分，还包含同义词、行粒度、关系以及助手在回答时读取的使用指南。在 SQL 中像引用表一样引用模型：select * from models.customers。定义一次，即可像表一样查询。
products.description: Basedash Models is a semantic workspace of reusable, governed SQL for core business concepts—customers, orders, active accounts—so everyone works from the same trusted definition. Each model has dedicated views for details, columns, measures, and segments, plus synonyms, row grain, relationships, and usage guidance the assistant reads when it answers. Reference a model in SQL like a table: select * from models.customers. Define it once. Query it like a table.

products.name: Globenomics
products.tagline: Explore 3D globe, 16 games, and 195 countries up for auction
products.summaryZh: 探索3D地球仪、16款游戏及195个国家，即将拍卖。
products.descriptionZh: 16款地理游戏，尽在可自由探索的3D地球仪上。速通195个国家，匹配首都，猜国旗，与朋友对决，更多玩法等你来战。游戏以GlobeMillions奖励你，国家可进行拍卖。赢得一国，即可持有24小时：你的头像和名字将显示在该国上，还能附上一条留言和一个推广链接，内容经审核后才会公开。持有时间最长者，即为国家之王。点击任一国家，即可查看GDP与工资、亿万富翁、独角兽企业、税收、护照实力、巨无霸指数等众多数据。
products.description: 16 geography games on a fully explorable 3D globe. Speedrun 195 countries, match capitals, guess flags, duel a friend and more Games pay you in GlobeMillions, and countries go to auction. Win one and you hold it for 24 hours: your avatar and name on that country, plus a note and one link to promote something, moderated before anyone sees it. Hold it longest, you're Country King. Click any country for GDP and wages, billionaires, unicorns, taxes, passport power, the Big Mac index and many more
